name: Forgent Power Solutions, Inc.
sector: Energy / Industrial Machinery & Components (electrical distribution equipment)
moat_justification: Narrow-moderate: real lead-time/customization edge in a capacity-short market, evidenced by share gains and a 3.3x book-to-bill, but no pricing power yet (gross margin fell as volume doubled), ROIC is one boom year at 14.5% with no through-cycle record, and the edge is replicable capacity and engineering labor against giants with far deeper benches.
fragility_flags: BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
THIN_HISTORY: only 2 fiscal years of data

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Forgent Power Solutions FY2026 10-K (filed 2026-09-15, period ended 2026-06-30), MD&A non-GAAP reconciliation 'Adjusted Diluted EPS': adjusted diluted weighted average shares outstanding 304,699 (in thousands) = diluted weighted average shares 243,802 + assumed exchange of Class B common stock 60,897 + dilutive effect of RSUs 270 (all in thousands)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
one_liner: AI data-center power-equipment roll-up growing 89% with a $3.0B backlog, moat 5/10 - but conservative owner's earnings are negative in both filed years (FY2026 OCF $109.1M vs capex $115.9M + SBC $10.0M, plus a $137.2M working-capital build), so Tier F at $31.68: it clears no hurdle until free cash flow turns positive.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Engineered-to-order customization with among the shortest lead times in the industry - the scarce input in a capacity-constrained electrical-equipment market
Single-source Powertrain Solutions bundles (transformer through PDU) cut customer integration risk; Powertrain revenue +259% in FY2026 to 25% of sales
UL-certified product breadth across the full electrical chain from four combined specialists (MGM transformers, PwrQ, States, VanTran)
Backlog $3.0B at Jun 30, 2026 (256% YoY, Q4 book-to-bill 3.3x) - multi-quarter revenue visibility competitors must displace order by order
moat_against: Far larger, deeply embedded competitors: Eaton, Schneider Electric, Vertiv, ABB, Siemens, Hitachi Energy
Gross margin compressed 36.9% to 35.0% while revenue grew 89% - no demonstrated pricing power
ROIC history is one boom year (roic_proxy 14.5% FY2026, FY2025 not computable) - unproven through a cycle
Demand is a single cyclical driver: AI data-center capex; backlog is cancellable purchase-order based work
Sponsor roll-up assembled 2023-24 (MGM, PwrQ, States, VanTran) - integration and culture unproven at 2x scale
Neos sponsor overhang: $1.5B+ of secondary sales since the Feb 2026 IPO and 44.5M exchangeable Class B shares remain
